class.name: NNCustomSearchCriterion
class.brief_description: Filters and scores candidate nodes with [method on_apply_criterion].
class.description: With the custom search criterion, you override [method on_apply_criterion]. For each candidate node in the search space, [member NNNQSSearchCriteria.is_filtered] is reset to [code]false[/code] and [member NNNQSSearchCriteria.score] is reset to [code]1.0[/code] before [method on_apply_criterion] is called with the candidate [Node]. Inside [method on_apply_criterion], set [member NNNQSSearchCriteria.is_filtered] to [code]true[/code] to filter the node out, and set [member NNNQSSearchCriteria.score] to the desired score. If the script does not override [method on_apply_criterion], nodes are left unfiltered with a score of [code]1.0[/code].

method.name: on_apply_criterion
method.description: Decides whether the candidate [param node] is filtered out and how it scores. Set [member NNNQSSearchCriteria.is_filtered] to [code]true[/code] to filter the node out, and set [member NNNQSSearchCriteria.score] to the desired score. May be omitted by scripts.
